newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybeans end sharply down on selling.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybeans end sharply down on selling.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended sharply down in active trading on Wednesday due to institutional selling, traders said.
The key January 1997 contract ended at an intra-day low of 3,152 yuan ($379) per tonne, losing 46 yuan. It opened at 3,170 and hit a high of 3,205.
March fell 89 to 3,149, May 104 to 3,221, July 45 to 3,330, September 20 to 3,368 and November 20 to 3,380.
Combined volume rose sharply to 21,900 tonnes from 11,000.
